Definition: from G4413; to be first (in rank or influence):--have the preeminence.
BiblicalUsage: Proteuo means to be first, to have the preeminence. It appears once, of Christ: He is the head of the body, the church, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things He might have the preeminence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe preeminence is His by right: He is first in creation, first from the dead, and first in the church, and there is no place where He is second.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
